ValidationRule.description: Declared volume must match L x W x H within 2%, and density (kg/m3) must be between 1 and 20000 using logarithmic bounds.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NULLVALUE(Length_Cm__c, 0) > 0, NULLVALUE(Width_Cm__c, 0) > 0, NULLVALUE(Height_Cm__c, 0) > 0, NULLVALUE(Volume_M3__c, 0) > 0, OR( ABS(Volume_M3__c - Length_Cm__c * Width_Cm__c * Height_Cm__c / 1000000) > 0.02 * Volume_M3__c, LOG(NULLVALUE(Weight_Kg__c, 0) / Volume_M3__c + 1) > LOG(20000), NULLVALUE(Weight_Kg__c, 0) / Volume_M3__c < EXP(0) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Volume does not match dimensions or density is out of range.
